name: Search Discovery
description: Generic web-search discovery. Composes queries from templates per entity and runs them against pluggable search providers (Perplexity, Serper, Brave, SerpAPI, ...). Two modes: open web search, or site-restricted fan-out over a configured domain list. Adding a provider = JSON config, not code.
usage_notes: Configure at least one provider (JSON config; see README for schemas and ready-made provider blocks). All vertical flavor — directory site lists, news whitelists, qualifier terms — belongs in template presets, not module defaults. site_restricted mode multiplies queries (templates x sites x entities); the max_queries_per_entity cap is the cost guard. Pagination is opt-in via max_pages_per_query and provider.pagination. Requests run breadth first; inspect meta.search_routes for page counts and stop reasons. Rescue budgets belong in template options.

options.name: providers
options.label: Search providers
options.description: Array of provider config objects. kind 'serp': query-based engine (endpoints per vertical, results_path, field_map, auth via env var). kind 'lookup': deterministic URL template per entity, HEAD-verified. No providers = loud no-op. See README for schema and examples.

options.name: search_mode
options.label: Search mode
options.description: open: each query template runs as-is per entity. site_restricted: each template fans out per domain in the site list (site: operator, or the provider's domain-filter param).

options.name: site_list
options.label: Site list
options.description: One domain per line; # lines are comments. Used only in site_restricted mode.

options.name: site_list_doc
options.label: Site list document
options.description: Reference-doc alternative to the site list textarea (one domain per line). If both are set, the document wins.

options.name: query_templates
options.label: Query templates
options.description: Array of query strings. Placeholders: {entity_name}, {alt_names}, {website_domain}, {site}. Templates whose placeholder has no value for an entity are skipped for that entity with a warning.

options.name: result_type
options.label: Result type
options.description: SERP vertical. Providers without an endpoint for the selected vertical are skipped with a warning.

options.name: date_range
options.label: Date range
options.description: Recency filter, mapped per provider via its date_param config. Providers without date_param ignore it.

options.name: max_results_per_query
options.label: Results per page
options.description: Legacy option name: number requested per page via num_param, not a total per query or entity. Provider/account limits still apply.

options.name: max_queries_per_entity
options.label: Max queries per entity
options.description: Hard cost cap on templates x sites per entity (applies per provider). Excess combinations are dropped with a loud log line.

options.name: max_pages_per_query
options.label: Max pages per query
options.description: Pages per query and provider. Requires provider.pagination; unsupported providers run once and report pagination_not_configured. Short pages do not stop pagination.

options.name: max_search_requests_per_entity
options.label: Max search requests per entity
options.description: Shared SERP request budget across queries and providers, including retries. 0 adds no request cap (page/query caps still apply). Excludes lookup and optional liveness HEAD requests.

options.name: empty_pages_to_stop
options.label: Consecutive empty pages before stopping
options.description: Stop this query after this many consecutive empty result arrays. This is an observed stop condition, not proof the web is exhausted.

options.name: duplicate_pages_to_stop
options.label: Consecutive duplicate pages before stopping
options.description: Stop after consecutive nonempty pages add no new URL to this query. Duplicates from other queries do not count.

options.name: max_rate_limit_retries
options.label: Retries after HTTP 429
options.description: Retry the same page with backoff and Retry-After, at most this many times. Every attempt uses rate and request budgets; cooldowns over 60 seconds stop the provider.

options.name: requests_per_minute
options.label: Rate limit (requests/min)
options.description: Global rate limit across all providers and entities.

options.name: verify_liveness
options.label: Verify result liveness
options.description: HEAD-check result URLs; drops hard-dead links (404/410) but keeps bot-walled ones (403 etc.). Lookup providers are always verified regardless of this option.

output_schema.title: string
output_schema.search_provenance: array of { provider, query, site, page, page_value }
